title: FindingView
description: Finding resource projection (findings_application; system of record is finding_events_store). Schema: docs/spec/contracts/inspection/finding_contract.yaml and finding_lifecycle/states.yaml.

finding_id.description: Unique finding identifier (UUID). Assigned at creation by the inspection pipeline.

inspection_id.description: Reference to the inspection that produced this finding.

control_id.description: Execution ID of the source directive (CG-IR node directive_id).

lineage_id.description: Immutable lineage root of the source directive. Never changes across revisions.

fsm_state.description: Current FSM state per finding_lifecycle.states contract. 11 states defined; Created, Dismissed, Superseded, and Closed are terminal.

severity.description: Finding severity computed from detection outcome and deontic modality. Permission Fail findings are always informational.

outcome.description: Raw detection outcome from the inspection evaluation.

confidence.description: Evaluator confidence score. Below threshold (default 0.5) caps severity at informational.

location.description: Location within the target where the finding was detected. Structure varies by target_type: code targets use file/line/function, config targets use path-based addressing, binary targets use offset/section.

file.description: File path within the target (for text/structured targets).

line_start.description: Starting line number (1-indexed, for text targets).

line_end.description: Ending line number (1-indexed, inclusive, for text targets).

column_start.description: Starting column number (1-indexed, for text targets).

column_end.description: Ending column number (1-indexed, exclusive, for text targets).

function.description: Enclosing function or method name (for code targets).

offset.description: Byte offset from beginning (for binary targets).

section.description: Section or segment name (for binary/document targets).

resource_path.description: Resource path in structured data (for Kubernetes, Terraform, etc.).

evidence.description: Evaluator evidence supporting the finding. Structure depends on detection strategy.

matched_pattern.description: Pattern or rule that triggered the finding.

metrics.description: Quantitative evidence (e.g. complexity scores, line counts).

reasoning.description: Evaluator reasoning chain explaining why this finding was produced.

paired_policy_ref.description: Reference to the paired policy doctrine entry. Used for guidance_only resolution (never for evaluation or FSM transitions per gate AA-02).

actor.description: Actor ID of the last state transition.

comments.description: Mandatory for Rejected→Open (TR-FL-009) and Open→Superseded (TR-FL-012) transitions. Captures the rationale for reopening or superseding a finding.

created_at.description: Finding creation timestamp (ISO 8601, UTC). Equal to updated_at on creation.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of most recent FSM transition (ISO 8601, UTC).

evidence.description: String interpolation detected in SQL query construction

context_lines.content: query = f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE name='{username}'"

example.reasoning: The login function constructs a SQL query using f-string interpolation with the username parameter. This creates a SQL injection vector because user input is directly embedded in the query string without sanitization or parameterization.
